evidence.reason: `noteAddressTerminalBookkeeping` stores all entries in a single `session.bookkeeping` slot even though the session is token-scoped and can serve multiple checkout roots (the neighboring `verifiedHeads` map is already keyed by `root`, and `removeAddressTerminalCandidate` retrieves the session only by token). Recording bookkeeping for a second root therefore replaces the first root's entries, so settlement for the first root can no longer find its own bookkeeping digest. This is an implementation defect in the existing map handling; the smallest compatible fix is to keep bookkeeping keyed by root rather than adding a new requirement.
